name: Emerging Researcher of the Year
description: For a researcher within seven years of their doctorate showing exceptional promise and output.

name: Research Excellence Award
description: For a sustained body of internationally recognised research.

name: Outstanding Educator Award
description: For transformative teaching, mentorship or curriculum innovation.

name: Industry Innovation Leader
description: For an individual driving research-informed innovation within their organisation.

name: Skills Champion of the Year
description: For exceptional contribution to workforce skills development.

name: Institutional Excellence in Research
description: For a department or institution demonstrating outstanding research culture and output.

name: Excellence in Skills Development
description: For an organisation with exemplary training and development programmes.

name: Research Impact Award
description: For a project with demonstrable social, economic or environmental benefit beyond academia. New for 2026.

name: Best Professor
description: For a professor demonstrating outstanding teaching, scholarship and contribution to their department.

name: Best Academic Chairman
description: For a department or programme chair showing exceptional academic leadership and vision.

name: Best Dean
description: For a dean whose leadership has elevated the academic standing and student experience of their faculty.

name: Best Computer Faculty
description: For a computer science or IT faculty member delivering outstanding teaching and research.

name: Best Academic Administrator
description: For an administrator whose management has strengthened academic operations and outcomes.

name: Best ASDF Student Project
description: For an outstanding student project completed under an ASDF-affiliated programme or chapter.

name: Best ASDF Student
description: For a student member of an ASDF chapter demonstrating outstanding academic and extracurricular achievement.

name: Best ASDF Chapter
description: For an ASDF student chapter demonstrating outstanding activity, engagement and impact.

name: Best Chief Executive Officer
description: For a CEO demonstrating exceptional strategic leadership and organisational growth.

name: Best Chief Operating Officer
description: For a COO driving operational excellence and organisational performance.

name: Best Chief Finance Officer
description: For a CFO demonstrating outstanding financial stewardship and strategic insight.

name: Best Entrepreneur
description: For an entrepreneur building a business of exceptional impact, innovation or growth.

name: Best Woman Entrepreneur
description: For a woman entrepreneur demonstrating outstanding leadership and business achievement.

name: Best Young Entrepreneur
description: For an entrepreneur under 35 building a business of exceptional impact or innovation.

name: Best Human Resources Manager
description: For an HR leader demonstrating excellence in talent strategy and workplace culture.

name: Best Academic Researcher
description: For a researcher within an academic institution producing outstanding, high-impact work.

name: Best Industry Researcher
description: For a researcher within industry producing outstanding, high-impact applied work.

name: Best Scientific Researcher
description: For a researcher whose scientific work has made a significant contribution across academia or industry.

name: Lifetime Achievements Awards
description: For sustained, career-long contribution and impact across research, education or industry.

name: Best Infrastructure Institute
description: For an institution demonstrating outstanding campus infrastructure and learning facilities.

name: Best Academic Institute
description: For an institution demonstrating outstanding academic standards and student outcomes.

name: Best Resourceful Institute
description: For an institution making exceptional use of resources to support teaching, research and students.

name: Best Automated Institute
description: For an institution demonstrating outstanding adoption of automation and digital systems.

name: Best Communication Institute
description: For an institution demonstrating outstanding internal and external communication practices.

name: Best Structured Institute
description: For an institution demonstrating an exceptionally well-structured academic and administrative framework.
